title: Export configuration with normalized keys
prompt: I need to export imported configuration labels as ASCII slugs. First make slugify handle compatibility characters such as full-width letters and ligatures according to its existing docstring. Then add textkit.config.slug_config(values), returning configuration text whose keys are those slugs and whose string values are unchanged. Keep input order and leave the mapping untouched; reject empty or colliding slugs and values format_config cannot represent. Empty input should return an empty string.
parts: Export slug_config using the normalized keys, rejecting collisions and unrepresentable entries.
